about: What a guitarist said about shapes on a neck, written down before the model
that has to reproduce it. Every entry here came from a person playing the
shape and saying what it was like, not from anything the code produced.
A grip reads sixth string first: 'x-3-2-0-1-0' is an open C. Fingers read
the same way, '-' for a string nobody holds: '- 3 2 - 1 -'.
The rule this file exists to enforce: a model is measured against all of it
at once, never against the last case that came in. Fitting one judgement at
a time is how the model this replaces ended up with twelve terms.
If two judgements here ever turn out to disagree, they are written down as
disagreeing and the player arbitrates. None do today.

ratio: if the index and the middle are one unit of awkward, the middle
and the ring are half again and the ring and the little finger nearly
three times. Measured one string apart, hand along the fret.
